findings.evidence: subprocess.run(["git", "-C", root, ...], capture_output=True) with no env= on every call

predicate_reproducibility.evidence: the frozen sentence runs guard-battery.py --root . --rev <measured> --json-out <receipt> and requires target_pin.matched true, but matched = bool(expect_sha256) and expect_sha256 == actual; without --expect-sha256 the run exits 0 with ok true and target_pin.matched false (c3-at-head.json), with it matched true (c3-at-head-pinned.json)
predicate_reproducibility.impact: the frozen sentence cannot be reproduced from its own command; the L1 landing receipt carries expected == actual == df6fb856..., so the flag was used at landing but is not in the sentence
predicate_reproducibility.remediation: append --expect-sha256 <gate blob digest> to the frozen command, or default the expectation to the gate blob at --rev
